The '''Hungarian Central Statistical Office''' ('''HSCO'''; {{langx|hu|Központi Statisztikai Hivatal (KSH)}}, {{IPA|hu|ˈkøsponti ʃtɒtistikɒji hivɒtɒl}}) is a [[quango]] responsible<ref name="legislation"/><ref name="eureg"/> for collecting, processing and publishing statistics about [[Hungary]], its economy, and its inhabitants. The office provides details for parliamentary and administrative offices, local councils and academia, financial institutions, the public at large and the media.

==Functions==
* To devise and conduct surveys
* To demand collection of statistical data for  the central state statistical system
* To process and analyse information from the collection of statistical data based on compulsory and voluntary data supply
* To supply data and analysis for state organizations
* To satisfy requests from non-governmental organisations, parties, local government, academic researchers and the general public
*To prepare and make the [[census]] and to process and publish the data from it.

==Regulation==
Legal reference: [http://portal.ksh.hu/portal/page?_pageid=38,119959&_dad=portal&_schema=PORTAL KSH - Rules on Statistics]

*Organization of National Statistics Act No. XXV of 1874
*Hungarian Royal Central Statistical Office Act No XXXV of 1897
*Official Statistical Service Act No XIX of 1929
*State Statistics Act No VI. of 1952
*Statistics Act No. V. of 1973
*Statistics Act No. XLVI of 1993<ref name="legislation">{{cite web
|title=Act XLVI of 1993 On Statistics
|date=1993
|publication-date=1 January 2007
|publisher=[[National Assembly of Hungary]]
|url=http://portal.ksh.hu/portal/page?_pageid=38,123598&_dad=portal&_schema=PORTAL
}}</ref>

The organisation is also covered by [[European Union]] regulation.<ref name="eureg">{{cite web
|title=Regulation (EC) No 223/2009 Of the European Parliament and of the Council
|date=11 March 2009
|work=[[Official Journal of the European Union]]
|publication-date=31 March 2009
|url=http://portal.ksh.hu/pls/portal/docs/PAGE/KSHPORTALENG/INTRODUCTION/ACTS_ON_STATISTICS/EUSTT_EN_OJ.PDF
}}</ref>

==Organization structure==
There are around  1,050 people employed at the central office, with a further 450 at regional offices.<ref>{{cite web
|url=http://portal.ksh.hu/portal/page?_pageid=38,119963&_dad=portal&_schema=PORTAL
|title=HCSO Introduction
|publisher=Hungarian Central Statistical Office
|access-date=19 September 2009
}}</ref>

The head of the Office is called the President, and leads a number of organizational units each headed by a Deputy President and having several departments:<ref>{{cite web
|url=http://portal.ksh.hu/portal/page?_pageid=38,119971&_dad=portal&_schema=PORTAL
|title=Organizational scheme of the HCSO
|publisher=Hungarian Central Statistical Office
|access-date=19 September 2009
}}</ref><ref>{{cite web
|url=http://portal.ksh.hu/pls/portal/docs/PAGE/KSHPORTALENG/INTRODUCTION/ORGANIZATIONAL/ORGANIZATIONAL%20SCHEME_080927.PDF
|title=Organizational Scheme
|publisher=Hungarian Central Statistical Office
|date=27 September 2008
|access-date=19 September 2009
}}</ref>

*Departments reporting directly to the president
**Internal Audit Section
**Administration and International
*Departments reporting to the Deputy President responsible for statistical issues
**Price Statistics
**Living Standards and Labour Statistics
**Foreign Trade Statistics
**Agriculture and Environment Statistics
**National Accounts
**Population Statistics
**Statistical Research and Methodology Department
**Sector Accounts
**Services Statistics
**Social Services Statistics
**Business Statistics
*Departments reporting to the Deputy President responsible for economic affairs
**Financial Management
**Technical and System Monitoring
**Information Technology
**Dissemination
**Planning
**Directorates
